description: Graphify graph of AgentShield: an AI-agent governance control plane (two gates, policy DSL, risk engine, 20-employee digital-twin simulation, 2D office console) with a ports-and-adapters core that runs identically local (SQLite/mock) and AWS (DynamoDB/Bedrock).

stack.backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI 0.115, Pydantic v2, aiosqlite, boto3/moto, scikit-learn (IsolationForest), ulid-py
stack.frontend: Vite 6, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind v4, Zustand 5, TanStack Query/Virtual, Recharts, CodeMirror, HTML5 canvas renderer

invariants: I1: vendor SDKs (boto3/aiosqlite/...) confined to adapters/<env>/ (ruff banned-api + AST guard)
I2: only container.py imports adapters; everything else depends on ports/
I3: only config.py reads AGENTSHIELD_ENV; only container.py branches on it
I4: risk/ has no path to ground-truth labels (AST guard + RiskScopedDocStore raises on GT# keys)
I5: TelemetryEmitter.emit() is the single choke point; no module writes events directly
I6: gates are pure (context in, DecisionResult out); callers own persistence/emission
I7: precedence block > review > redact > allow is fixed, never configurable; Gate 2 has no redact
I8: fails closed: any gate exception => BLOCK (reason_code=gate_error)
I9: seq is a monotonic per-run counter; ordering is always by seq, never wall time
I10: approvals expiry and sweeps run on sim time (clock.sim_ts), never wall time
I11: raw secrets never leave Gate 1; raw prompt lives only in the blob store under raw/{task_id}/prompt.json
I12: everything in sim is seeded and deterministic from run.seed; advance() forces MockLLM

nodes.label: tasks.py — task runner
nodes.summary: Stdlib-only cross-platform Makefile replacement. 28 targets: setup, dev, check, seed, seed-history, advance, demo, evaluate, export-dataset, contracts, check-secrets, repro-check, train-risk.

nodes.label: FastAPI app factory
nodes.summary: Lifespan owns container + services; warms policy cache; mounts routers under /api/v1; /healthz names each adapter; /readyz requires docstore + armed policies; installs CORS (no wildcard) and error handlers.

nodes.label: Container (composition root)
nodes.summary: The ONLY file that branches on AGENTSHIELD_ENV. Picks one adapter per port at startup; describe() surfaces the wiring on /healthz; deterministic_llm() is the sanctioned door for sim/ to get a seeded MockLLM.

nodes.label: Settings
nodes.summary: The ONLY file that reads AGENTSHIELD_ENV (loads, never branches). Typed pydantic-settings: env, LLM provider, sim params, risk weights, ingest tokens (token->actor server-side), AWS resources. Paths resolve against repo root.

nodes.label: Services + WebSocketHub
nodes.summary: Assembles the whole object graph once (policies, counters, risk stack, emitter, gates, approvals, sandbox, seeder, engine). Wraps docstore in RiskScopedDocStore for risk/. get_services() is lru_cached; reset_services() for tests.

nodes.label: DocStorePort
nodes.summary: DynamoDB-shaped KV store adopted (not abstracted): put/batch_put/get/query(key-conditions only)/update($add)/delete. Zero-padded sort keys; access patterns A1-A25 enumerated in docs/05-BACKEND-SCHEMA.md.

nodes.label: LLMPort
nodes.summary: complete(messages, tools, model) -> LLMResult{text, tool_calls[], usage, model_id, stop_reason}. Mirrors Bedrock Converse tool-use shape.

nodes.label: BlobStorePort
nodes.summary: Raw prompt archive (raw/{task_id}/prompt.json) and exports. FsBlobStore locally, S3 in AWS.

nodes.label: EventBusPort
nodes.summary: EventBridge-shaped envelopes from day one; MemoryBus+outbox locally, EventBridge in AWS.

nodes.label: MetricsPort
nodes.summary: count/gauge/timing; StdoutMetrics emits EMF JSON locally, CloudWatch EMF in AWS.

nodes.label: QueuePort
nodes.summary: AsyncioQueue locally, SQS in AWS.

nodes.label: SecretsPort
nodes.summary: DotenvSecrets locally, Secrets Manager in AWS.

nodes.label: ClockPort
nodes.summary: One implementation on purpose (SimClock): simulated time is domain logic. now_wall only for log lines.

nodes.label: Gate 1 — request governance
nodes.summary: Pure, fails closed. Steps: scan prompt (7 detectors) -> budget pre-flight -> policy match -> precedence resolve. Budget beats policy on purpose. Route override can downgrade the model. Secrets always REDACT.

nodes.label: Gate 2 — action governance
nodes.summary: Pure, fails closed. resolve_resource() derives target_resource, sensitivity (secret path/prod deploy => CRITICAL), is_secret_path, is_protected_branch, is_external_host. No redact (degrades to review). approver_for/ttl_for feed the approval round-trip.

nodes.label: PolicyEngine
nodes.summary: Linear scan over cached enabled policies per gate; cache invalidated on write only; append-only versioning (V# + CURRENT pointer); malformed policy degrades itself, never the gate; cached_policy serves hot-path lookups.

nodes.label: Policy DSL
nodes.summary: 11 operators, 3 combinators, fixed field allowlists per gate (source deliberately absent). Unknown field = validation error with JSON path + 'did you mean'. MAX_DEPTH 5, MAX_CONDITIONS 25, regex cap 200 chars.

nodes.label: Precedence
nodes.summary: block > review > redact > allow — fixed, never configurable. Priority decides attribution only; ties break on policy id for a stable trace.

nodes.label: Secret scanner
nodes.summary: 7 regex detectors; mask <<REDACTED:type:sha256[:4]>>; overlapping spans resolved widest-first; findings in events carry detector+mask only. Raw value only ever in blob store.

nodes.label: BudgetGuard
nodes.summary: Pre-flight employee+team cap check against counters ($add aggregates); team cap = sum(member caps) x 0.8; message names the projected figure, not a policy id.

nodes.label: ApprovalEngine
nodes.summary: review holds and routes a decision card. Terminal states immutable (2nd decide = 409). TTL sweep on sim_ts each tick. approve_session grants tool|resource|env for that task only. APPRIDX# for direct id lookup.

nodes.label: Policy Lab (replay)
nodes.summary: Replays draft against recorded gate decisions using stored context_snapshot (~2KB/decision, deliberate). Reports requests_affected, projected savings, newly_blocked_previously_succeeded (the false-positive proxy), extra approvals/day.

nodes.label: AgentRunner (tool-use loop)
nodes.summary: max_iterations cap; model + tool calls cost-accounted per iteration; every tool call re-enters Gate 2; a BLOCK returns as a tool result (never an exception) so the model's reaction is telemetry; session grants skip re-gating; repeat-digest window 5 sim-min.

nodes.label: Model router + PRICE_TABLE
nodes.summary: Single source of every cost figure. route() honours policy override > requested (if priced) > complexity table; local prices mirror cloud so demo numbers hold; price_for never raises; estimate_tokens powers pre-flight budget.

nodes.label: Tool schemas (8)
nodes.summary: Bedrock Converse toolSpec shapes: read_file, edit_file, run_tests, git_commit, git_push, call_api, deploy, external_fetch. Closed list by design.

nodes.label: Prompts
nodes.summary: build_prompt embeds task_type=... so MockLLM branches on the same surface a real model sees; blocked_result wording tells the model a block is deliberate policy, not a transient error.

nodes.label: Sandbox executor
nodes.summary: Fully simulated: seeded draws, no real network/deploys. external_fetch consults allowlist, returns canned response; run_tests pass/fail biased by mistake_probability (sloppy decoy fails more).

nodes.label: VirtualFileSystem
nodes.summary: 6 seeded repos with file trees in the DocStore (REPO#x/FILE#path); secret files exist so blocking one is a real, blockable event.

nodes.label: SimulationEngine
nodes.summary: Tick loop (60 sim-seconds), speeds 1/10/100, downshift on overrun; expiry sweep first; tasks from diurnal curve; max 4 concurrent sessions; per-session gate1 -> runner -> finalise; advance() forces MockLLM and drains; busy blocks control actions except pause.

nodes.label: SimClock
nodes.summary: sim_ts only moves via advance(); sim_hour/sim_date derived; nothing infers elapsed sim time from wall time.

nodes.label: TaskGenerator
nodes.summary: Diurnal curve makes off-hours rare and meaningful; behaviour (ladder/sloppy) modulates repo/env/type draws; ~6% prompts embed seeded fake secrets; marquee rate 0.08 invokes real LLM.

nodes.label: Personas + adversarial ladder
nodes.summary: 6 archetypes x seeded jitter; LADDER time-gates the adversary: baseline(1-3) recon(4-5) credential probing(6-7) egress(8-9) volume(10-11) restricted ops(12+); release-week decoy days 9-10; sloppy decoy is expensive-not-malicious.

nodes.label: ScenarioEngine
nodes.summary: Only producer of ground truth: emits via emitter(..., ground_truth=...) to GT# keys risk/ cannot read. Injects ladder steps (recon reads, secret variants, egress hosts, restricted ops) and demo beats from scenarios/demo.yaml.

nodes.label: Seeder
nodes.summary: Deterministic company from seed: 20 employees (roster verbatim), 6 repos, 13 policies (12 + Policy Lab draft), VFS, desks from office_map (desk assignment server-side for honest rehydration).

nodes.label: Seed data
nodes.summary: Acme Payments: 4 teams, 6 repos, 20 employees (emp_017 adversarial, emp_014 sloppy), 12 policies incl. route-override downgrade and secret-read block; SECRET_PATHS + EXTERNAL_ALLOWLIST.

nodes.label: Office floor plan (server-side)
nodes.summary: 5 rooms as floating islands, 20+ desks; iso projection + depth = (tx+ty) so sprites never hide behind desks; desk_for_slot is the seed<->renderer contract.

nodes.label: SnapshotBuilder
nodes.summary: Office rehydration payload: avatars (FSM from task status, badge overlay at risk>=70, hysteresis off at 60), pending approvals, seq cursor for stream resume.

nodes.label: TelemetryEmitter (single choke point)
nodes.summary: Atomic per-run seq via $add + lock; durable write first (3 retries, then dead-letter.jsonl + degraded flag), fan-out (bus, WS, metrics, risk) never fails the emit; read_page via GSI layouts (type/employee filters); GT# written only for sim/ callers.

nodes.label: Counters
nodes.summary: Six counter families (emp/team/run/model/tool/waste) maintained on write with atomic $add; WASTE_STATUSES defines 'waste prevented' exactly once; nothing computed by scanning.

nodes.label: RiskEngine
nodes.summary: Observes every event; buffers open sessions in memory; scores at task.completed; persists RISK# profile + SESSION# vector; baseline updates AFTER scoring (an anomaly can't normalise itself); train() fits on all session vectors.

nodes.label: Composite scoring
nodes.summary: risk = 0.35 static + 0.40 behavioural + 0.25 ml; behavioural = sigmoid of weighted clipped z-scores (secret/egress weigh 2.0); explain() is the single source of plain-language wording.

nodes.label: 12-feature session vector
nodes.summary: accumulate() folds events into facts; z-scores clipped >= 0 (being quiet is not a signal); Shannon entropy over repos; fixed feature order for the forest.

nodes.label: Baselines
nodes.summary: Welford one-pass stats per employee vs their OWN history; archetype fallback below 20 sessions flagged low_confidence (hatched meter in UI).

nodes.label: AnomalyDetector (IsolationForest)
nodes.summary: Unsupervised by design; seeded; refuses to fit below 50 sessions; scores percentile-ranked to 0-100; feature_contributions is an honest proxy, scoring.top_factors is authoritative.

nodes.label: IncidentManager
nodes.summary: Opens at composite>=70 for 2 consecutive sessions or any static-critical; merges within 24 sim-hours; evidence capped at 40 rows; summary derived from evidence, never the label.

nodes.label: RiskScopedDocStore
nodes.summary: Runtime half of label isolation: raises LabelLeakError on any GT# read/write, filters GT# from wide range results.

nodes.label: Enums
nodes.summary: Decision (allow/redact/review/block), Gate, Role, Archetype, ScenarioProfile (never exposed via API), Environment (action target, not deployment env), ToolName, TaskStatus, ApprovalStatus, Sensitivity, SimSpeed, Source (telemetry only).

nodes.label: Domain models
nodes.summary: EmployeePublic lacks scenario_profile at the type level; RequestContext/ActionContext are the mode-parity boundary (policy_view() excludes source); Task.transition_to enforces the status FSM; digest_args makes repeat counting possible; GateRequest/AgentAction carry context_snapshot for replay.

nodes.label: Event envelope
nodes.summary: EventBridge-shaped EventEnvelope + GroundTruthRecord; seq is the only ordering.

nodes.label: Generated event payloads
nodes.summary: GENERATED from packages/contracts/events.schema.json via tasks.py contracts; EVENT_TYPES registry drives /ingest/events validation (never a hardcoded count).

nodes.label: POST /sim/runs, /control, /advance, GET /state
nodes.summary: Create+seed runs (optionally 14-day history), start/pause/speed (409 during fast-forward except pause), advance streams progress frames, state returns snapshot.

nodes.label: GET /employees, /tasks, /events, /approvals + decide
nodes.summary: A3-A14 access patterns; /tasks/{id} assembles the full trace in one query (single-table payoff); approval cards carry risk, cost and requester's 7-day rate for the tool.

nodes.label: /policies CRUD + /policy-lab
nodes.summary: Append-only versions; /validate dry-run for editor autocomplete (fields_used); /fields publishes per-gate allowlists; /policy-lab/simulate and /promote.

nodes.label: /risk/employees, /explain, /incidents
nodes.summary: Leaderboard via RISKRANK GSI; /explain returns top factors + baseline comparison + recent contributors; never the scenario label.

nodes.label: /metrics/summary, /spend
nodes.summary: Exec view from counters; team risk = MAX of members (a mean hides the compromised account); why_high names evidence, not a number.

nodes.label: /ingest/gate1, /gate2, /events (Live Mode)
nodes.summary: Bearer token -> actor server-side (role cannot be self-asserted); builds the same contexts and calls the same gate functions as sim; 100 rps/token rate limit; source=live is telemetry only.

nodes.label: /ws/stream
nodes.summary: since=seq cursor replay; gap>500 => resnapshot instruction; 15s heartbeat; coalescing is speed-aware (1x per-event, 10x 250ms batches).

nodes.label: Request schemas
nodes.summary: Validation before domain code; PolicyCreate runs DSL validation and forbids redact at gate 2 and review without approver; consistent {data:...} envelope.

nodes.label: Local adapters
nodes.summary: SqliteDocStore (DynamoDB emulator: single items table, 3 key patterns, LIKE-escape, keyset cursors, $add, TTL sweep), FsBlobStore, MemoryBus+outbox, AsyncioQueue, StdoutMetrics (EMF), DotenvSecrets, MockLLM (seeded scripted tool sequences per task type), OllamaAdapter.

nodes.label: AWS adapters
nodes.summary: DynamoDocStore, S3BlobStore, EventBridgeBus, SqsQueue, CloudWatchEmfMetrics, SecretsManagerSecrets, BedrockAdapter (Converse API), boto3 sync on asyncio.to_thread (moto contract-test fidelity).

nodes.label: Contract generator
nodes.summary: events.schema.json -> Pydantic + TS types, both committed; shared EventEnvelope; OFFICE_EVENT_TYPES (6 events) keeps the canvas pump inside budget.

nodes.label: App shell + routes
nodes.summary: One WebSocket for the app lifetime (survives navigation); routes: /office, /live, /approvals, /control{,/policies,/policy-lab,/employees,/costs,/risk,/incidents}; EmployeeDrawer shared by office and grid.

nodes.label: Zustand stores
nodes.summary: telemetryStore (WS-owned ring buffers: 2000 events, 400 office queue, 200 log; pause buffers + resume) vs simStore (REST-owned run/employees/avatars; applyEvent folds events into avatar FSM; anomaly overlay with hysteresis 70/60). Never reconciled because they never overlap.

nodes.label: api.ts + ws.ts
nodes.summary: Typed fetch with ApiError{code,field} for editor underlining; connectStream resumes from lastSeq, capped exponential backoff, ping keepalive, resnapshot on gap>500.

nodes.label: Canvas office renderer
nodes.summary: OfficeSimulation.tsx owns the RAF loop + camera (drag/wheel, zoom steps); WorldRenderer pre-renders rooms off-screen; PersonRenderer pixel sprites + halos; MotionSystem walk/idle; HUD plates/pills/popover in DOM; reads simStore only — renderer over telemetry, no authority.

nodes.label: Console routes
nodes.summary: office (full-bleed sim), live (virtualised feed), approvals (1-click cards), control/* (overview, policies editor + policy lab, employees, costs, risk, incidents).

nodes.label: AvatarGrid (card fallback)
nodes.summary: The non-canvas fallback that reads the same store; ships first and keeps working — if the canvas breaks, the product is still complete.

nodes.label: Detection evaluation
nodes.summary: The ONLY file that reads GT#. Computes recall/precision/FP rate (split sloppy vs release-week) and time-to-detection from recon; asserts PRD targets (recall>=0.80, FP<=0.05, ttd<=2d); warns recall~1.0 means label leakage.

nodes.label: Dataset export
nodes.summary: sessions/events/labels parquet in SEPARATE files + DATASET-CARD.md; labels are evaluation-only by construction.

nodes.label: Other infra scripts
nodes.summary: ws_tail (websocat replacement), reference_client (the 60-line Live Mode walkthrough), make_placeholder_atlas, render_office_map, build_character_spritesheet.

nodes.label: Port contract suites
nodes.summary: Same suite parameterised over local and moto-backed AWS adapters; a skipped aws param fails CI.

nodes.label: Architecture guard
nodes.summary: AST walk asserting I1-I4; sanity check that it scans >=20 files so it can't pass vacuously.

nodes.label: CLI scripts
nodes.summary: seed_run, advance, demo (5-beat unattended demo), repro_check (same seed twice => identical hash), check_secrets (canary scan must be zero), inspect_events, train_risk, run_task, gate_repl.
